errors.text_span: 分为两个子图：(a) 展示“生活工作类”动词的分布，(b) 展示“生理活动类”动词的分布
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the content of the subplots. According to the subplot titles in the image, (a) shows the distribution of "支配动词" (dominant verbs), and (b) shows the distribution of "承受动词" (patient verbs), not "生活工作类" (life/work class) and "生理活动类" (physiological activity class).

errors.text_span: “新闻”“网络文学”“网络小说”“微博”四类
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists the categories on the x-axis. The image shows "新闻" (News), "传统文学" (Traditional Literature), "网络小说" (Online Novels), and "微博" (Weibo). The description replaces "传统文学" with "网络文学".
The description fails to mention a crucial structural element of the chart: each register category on the x-axis is subdivided into two bars, one for "男性" (Male) and one for "女性" (Female).

errors.text_span: 在图(a)中，每个语体对应一个堆叠柱状图
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. For each register ("语体") in chart (a), there are two stacked bar charts: one for male and one for female.
The description hallucinates legend entries. The actual legend for chart (a) includes categories like "赠礼 (400)", "感觉 (44)", "生命.繁殖 (3814)", etc., not "工作", "社交", or "消费".

The description incorrectly states that the 'News' register has the lowest frequency. In chart (a), the 'Traditional Literature' register has the lowest frequency (Male: 16, Female: 186; Total: 202), which is much lower than the frequency for 'News' (Male: ~400, Female: 4356).

errors.text_span: 在图(b)中，每个语体对应一个单一柱状图
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. For each register in chart (b), there are two bars for male and female, although some values (like male for Weibo) are zero.
The value for the female bar in the 'News' category in chart (b) is 479, not 439.

The description incorrectly attributes the value 5748 to the 'Weibo' category. In chart (b), the value 5738 corresponds to the female bar in the '网络小说' (Online Novels) category. The value for the female bar in the 'Weibo' category is 18.

errors.text_span: “微博”中“进食”“睡眠”“排泄”等语义域占据主要部分
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates legend entries for chart (b). The legend does not contain "进食" (eating) or "排泄" (excreting). Furthermore, the 'Weibo' bars in chart (b) have very low frequencies (0 and 18), so no semantic domain occupies a 'main part' in a significant way.
The legends for charts (a) and (b) are different. They list different sets of semantic domain categories.

errors.text_span: “微博”在两类动词中均呈现显著高频
errors.evidence: This statement is an incorrect interpretation of the data. While 'Weibo' has a high-frequency bar in chart (a), it has one of the lowest frequencies in chart (b). The highest frequency bar in chart (b) belongs to '网络小说' (Online Novels).

errors.text_span: 所有数值均为绝对频次，无单位换算。
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "频次" (Frequency), which implies absolute counts. Stating this explicitly is redundant and does not add significant value.
